main_text.l: CAPVT XIV.
De Concione sive exhortatione funebri.
Ioannes Calvinus, in Epist. ad Mon-
sbelgardenses, Lib. Epist. Col. 56.
IN Sepultura mortuorum hanc modera-
tionem vellem adhiberi, ne in Templum
funus deferretur, sed recta in cametE-
rium. Illic quoque exhortationem ha-
beri vellem, vt in re praesenti funeris
comites agnoscerent quod diceretur. Haec ratio non ad-
modum improbanda foret. De Campanae pulsu nolim vos
pertinacius reclamare, si obtineri nequeat vt princeps
remittat: Non quia probem, sed quia rem contentio-
sae non dignam arbitror.
Tria hic observa ex verbis Calvini: 1. Optarem
distincta esse caemeteria, nec in Templis sepeliri mor-
tuos; quod & nos optamus. 2. Vt, ubi deponitur funus,
ibi fiat exhortatio funebris; & vicissim ubi fit exhortatio,
ibi praesens sit funus. 3. Si quae sint non magni momen-
ti, quae minus probemus, non tamen de eis pertinaciter
contendendum.
IN

page.notes: The first word "IN" of the opening is a large decorated initial "I" joined to "N". Some words in the first paragraph are printed with a tilde-like mark (e.g. "ne~", "quoque~") representing omitted letters; the printed "cametErium" is as printed. Marginal "I." at the right is a note mark. The text "IN" at the foot right is a catchword-like mark, transcribed in the foot paragraph; treat as doubtful.
